title: Pre-commit hook freshness check skips a checkout with no scripts/githooks
why: Every commit on the roadmap branch prints 'cd: scripts/githooks: No such file or directory'. The check then fails open, so nothing is blocked, but the false error teaches readers to skip hook output.
note: Fix: add [ -d scripts/githooks ] to the opening if of the freshness block in scripts/githooks/pre-commit. Also sent to the claude-settings gripes tracker. Still true on origin/main 2026-11-23 13:15 CST: scripts/githooks/pre-commit:126 runs `cd scripts/githooks` with no -d test (read by triage and by Sim Manager).
